dream_of_ancestors.title: A Message from the Departed
dream_of_ancestors.description: [initiator_name] dreamed of their ancestors last night — a procession of stern-faced elders pointing toward a distant peak, their mouths moving in silence. The impression lingered past dawn and into the morning forms.

effects.text: I dreamed of my ancestors. Their silent message guides my cultivation.

opt_dismiss_dream.text: Dismiss it as an idle dream. There is training to be done.

effects.text: A strange dream. I set it aside and returned to my training.

longing_for_home.title: The Road Not Taken
longing_for_home.description: [initiator_name] has been staring at the horizon more often than usual. Tonight, by the light of a single candle, they wrote a letter home — though they are not certain it will ever arrive.

opt_send_letter.text: Send the letter regardless. The act matters more than the arrival.

effects.text: I sent a letter home. Whether it arrives does not change its meaning.

opt_burn_letter.text: Burn it. Sentiment is a chain.

effects.text: I burned the letter. The path forward requires no anchors to the past.

old_grudge_resurfaces.title: An Old Wound Reopened
old_grudge_resurfaces.description: A careless word from a sect brother struck a buried nerve today. [initiator_name] has been reminded of an old shame — or an old enemy — that time has not fully erased.

opt_channel_into_training.text: Let the memory sharpen resolve. Anger forged properly becomes strength.

effects.text: I let the old wound fuel my training. Hatred is a blade that cuts both ways — but it cuts.

opt_release_grudge.text: Release the grudge. Carrying old debts weighs on the spirit.

effects.text: I released the old grudge. What remains is a cleaner heart and clearer meridians.

moment_of_clarity.title: The Still Point
moment_of_clarity.description: In the middle of morning forms, [initiator_name] stopped completely. For three full breaths, the world held still — and something in the pattern of movement suddenly made sense in a way it never had before.

opt_capture_insight.text: Immediately record the insight before it fades.

effects.text: A moment of perfect clarity during training. I committed the sensation to memory immediately.

opt_continue_training.text: Continue training without pause. The insight will deepen through practice.

effects.text: A moment of clarity came and went. I trusted my body to remember what my mind had grasped.

unexpected_illness.title: The Body Betrays
unexpected_illness.description: [initiator_name] woke with a burning fever and limbs like soaked wood. Their Qi flows sluggishly, and the thought of training feels distant.

opt_rest_fully.text: Rest fully. The body demands it.

effects.text: Illness struck me down. I rested for several days against my will.

opt_train_through.text: Train through it. Weakness is merely discomfort with a name.

effects.text: I refused to let illness stop my training. The price may come later.

recovery_from_illness.title: The Return of Strength
recovery_from_illness.description: [initiator_name] has recovered from their illness. They rise from their bed to find the world sharp and vivid again — and their hunger for the Dao renewed.

acknowledge.text: Return to training. There is much lost time to reclaim.

effects.text: I am recovered. Strange — the illness seems to have clarified something in my Qi flow.

night_terrors.title: What Waits in the Dark
night_terrors.description: [initiator_name] has been screaming in their sleep for three nights in a row. Their sect brothers avoid the corridor outside their room. The shadows in their eyes grow deeper each morning.

opt_seek_counsel.text: Seek counsel from a senior disciple or elder.

effects.text: I spoke to an elder about my nightmares. The conversation helped more than I expected.

opt_suppress_alone.text: Suppress the fear through sheer will. Show nothing.

effects.text: The nightmares cannot touch what I refuse to show. I train through the dark thoughts.

quiet_contemplation.title: A Moment of Peace
quiet_contemplation.description: [initiator_name] has found a secluded spot near the cliff's edge where no one else goes. For an afternoon there are no forms, no words, no duties — only the sound of wind and the distant mountains.

opt_spend_time_here.text: Sit a while longer. The stillness is itself a teaching.

effects.text: I found peace today in stillness. The Dao revealed itself in the space between thoughts.

opt_return_to_duties.text: Return to duties. Indulgence serves no one.

effects.text: I cut short my idle sitting and returned to training. Duty first.

jealousy_in_ranks.title: The Green Serpent
jealousy_in_ranks.description: A fellow disciple received praise today that [initiator_name] believed was rightfully theirs. The bitterness sits sour in their chest, and they have been watching their rival with calculating eyes.

opt_channel_envy.text: Use the envy to drive harder training. Let them eat your dust.

effects.text: Jealousy is a blade. I am sharpening myself against it.

opt_spread_rumors.text: Whisper doubts about the rival's character to others.

effects.text: I planted seeds of doubt about my rival. Let reputation wither from within.

opt_acknowledge_merit.text: Acknowledge their merit openly. Strength respects strength.

effects.text: I congratulated my rival openly. The words were difficult, but they were right.

disciple_begs_forgiveness.title: A Disciple Kneels
disciple_begs_forgiveness.description: [initiator_name] kneels before the Sect Master, forehead pressed to the ground. They have committed a serious error — broken a sect rule, shamed themselves in public, or failed an important task — and now they beg forgiveness.

opt_forgive_openly.text: Forgive them before the assembled disciples. Grace builds loyalty.

effects.text: The Sect Master of [initiator_sect_name] publicly forgave a disciple's error, demonstrating magnanimity.
The Sect Master forgave my failure before everyone. I will not waste that mercy.

opt_assign_penance.text: Assign a penance. Forgiveness must be earned, not given.

effects.text: I was assigned a penance for my failure. It is harsh but fair.

opt_expel.text: Expel them. Failure of this magnitude cannot be overlooked.

effects.text: The Sect Master expelled me for my failure. There is no return from this.

bond_between_disciples.title: Iron Sharpens Iron
bond_between_disciples.description: [initiator_name] and a sect brother have been spending long evenings comparing notes on technique and theory. What began as informal exchange has become something deeper — a bond forged in shared struggle.

opt_deepen_bond.text: Commit to a formal martial brotherhood pact.

effects.text: I forged a sworn brotherhood with a sect brother. Some bonds are worth more than technique.

opt_keep_distance.text: Maintain professional distance. Deep bonds breed weakness.

effects.text: I kept my distance. The Dao demands solitude. Attachments are chains.

fear_of_death.title: When the Lamp Gutters
fear_of_death.description: [initiator_name] lay awake until the third watch, staring at the ceiling. They are not sick — but they are acutely aware that they could die on any given day. The thought will not leave.

opt_embrace_mortality.text: Embrace mortality as a teacher. What matters if each day might be the last?

effects.text: I sat with the fear of death until it became a strange calm. The Dao cares nothing for our preferences.

opt_bury_fear.text: Bury the fear under training. Motion banishes thought.

effects.text: I buried the dark thoughts under exhaustion. Better to burn out in motion than rot in stillness.

personal_milestone.title: A Wall Broken Through
personal_milestone.description: After months of grinding effort, [initiator_name] finally broke through a stubborn technical barrier — a form that has resisted mastery, a stance that never quite felt right. Today it clicked, perfectly, as if it had always been there.

opt_celebrate_quietly.text: Mark the moment in silence. Growth needs no audience.

effects.text: I broke through a long-standing barrier today. The Dao is patient with those who are patient with themselves.

opt_share_insight.text: Share the discovery with a fellow disciple. Teaching reinforces learning.

effects.text: I shared my breakthrough with a sect brother. Teaching reinforces learning.

master_remembers_a_lesson.title: The Teacher's Shadow
master_remembers_a_lesson.description: A moment from your own training days surfaces unbidden: your teacher's voice, a specific correction to your stance, a lesson you half-understood then and only now fully grasp.

opt_apply_lesson.text: Apply the lesson to your current cultivation immediately.

effects.text: I remembered a teaching from my own master today. Some lessons are seeds that only bloom decades later.

opt_pass_on_lesson.text: Pass the lesson to a disciple who needs it. The chain of teaching must continue.

effects.text: [initiator_sect_name]'s leader was seen personally instructing a disciple in the courtyard this morning.
I passed on my master's teaching to one of my own disciples. The chain continues.
